version: "0.1"
title: "Markdown note-taking CLI"
objective: "A single-file, stdlib-only Python CLI (note_taker.py) with subcommands new, list, show, edit and delete that stores notes as .md files with YAML frontmatter in ~/.note-taker/ and finds notes by tag or keyword."
execution_mode: critical
context:
  system: "Empty Python repository on macOS; deliverable is note_taker.py at the repository root plus unittest tests under forgemyspec-bundle/note-taker/tests."
  assumptions:
    - "Notes dir is ~/.note-taker/, overridable by the NOTE_TAKER_DIR environment variable so tests never touch the real home."
    - "A note is identified by a slug id derived from its title, used as the file name <id>.md."
    - "Frontmatter is a simple subset of YAML (title, tags as a flow list, created) written and parsed by hand, since PyYAML is not stdlib."
    - "edit opens the note in $EDITOR (fallback vi); tests set EDITOR to a script."
    - "Python 3.9 or newer."
constraints:
  - "Standard library only; no third-party imports."
  - "All code lives in the single file note_taker.py."
  - "No sync, encryption, rendering to HTML or network access."
  - "No notes are stored outside the notes directory."
success_criteria:
  - "All five subcommands work end to end against a temporary notes directory."
  - "Unit tests for every obligation pass."
hypotheses:
  - {id: h1, description: "new creates <id>.md in the notes directory with YAML frontmatter (title, tags, created) followed by the body, creating the directory if missing.", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h2, description: "list prints one line per note and filters by --tag and by --search keyword (case-insensitive, matching title or body).", confidence: 0.85}
  - {id: h3, description: "show prints the note's frontmatter and body for a given id and exits 1 with a message for an unknown id.", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h4, description: "edit opens the note file in $EDITOR and validates the frontmatter afterwards; delete removes the file.", confidence: 0.8}
  - {id: h5, description: "The tool uses only the standard library and lives in the single file note_taker.py.", confidence: 0.95}
required_evidence:
  - "Output of python3 -m unittest showing all note_taker tests passing."
  - "Gate report with RESULT: PASS."
actions:
  - {id: a1, description: "Implement new, list, show, edit, delete and frontmatter handling in note_taker.py.", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5]}
  - {id: a2, description: "Write unittest boundary tests using a temporary NOTE_TAKER_DIR.", type: validate, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5]}
decision_rules:
  - "If a requirement needs a non-stdlib module, stop and ask."
  - "If a new subcommand or storage format is wanted, amend the spec first."
metadata:
  source_prompt: "Build a Markdown Note-Taking CLI. Subcommands: new, list, show, edit, delete. Store notes as .md files with YAML frontmatter in ~/.note-taker/. Search by tag or keyword. Single file note_taker.py, stdlib only."
  generator: claude-code-session
  scope_contract:
    must_include:
      - "subcommands new list show edit delete"
      - "notes stored as .md with YAML frontmatter in ~/.note-taker"
      - "search by tag or keyword"
      - "single file note_taker.py stdlib only"
formal:
  module: NoteTaker
  obligations:
    - id: new_writes_frontmatter_note
      kind: boundary
      statement: "new creates <id>.md with YAML frontmatter (title, tags, created) and the body in the notes directory, creating it if missing."
      hypotheses: [h1]
      must_include: ["notes stored as .md with YAML frontmatter in ~/.note-taker"]
      test: "test_note_taker.NoteTakerTests.test_new_writes_frontmatter_note"
    - id: list_search_filters
      kind: boundary
      statement: "list --tag filters by tag and list --search filters by case-insensitive keyword in title or body."
      hypotheses: [h2]
      must_include: ["search by tag or keyword"]
      test: "test_note_taker.NoteTakerTests.test_list_search_filters"
    - id: show_prints_or_fails
      kind: boundary
      statement: "show prints the note and exits 1 for an unknown id."
      hypotheses: [h3]
      must_include: ["subcommands new list show edit delete"]
      test: "test_note_taker.NoteTakerTests.test_show_prints_or_fails"
    - id: edit_and_delete
      kind: boundary
      statement: "edit launches $EDITOR on the note file and delete removes it; both exit 1 for an unknown id."
      hypotheses: [h4]
      must_include: ["subcommands new list show edit delete"]
      test: "test_note_taker.NoteTakerTests.test_edit_and_delete"
    - id: single_file_stdlib
      kind: boundary
      statement: "note_taker.py imports only standard library modules."
      hypotheses: [h5]
      must_include: ["single file note_taker.py stdlib only"]
      test: "test_note_taker.NoteTakerTests.test_single_file_stdlib"
scope:
  paths: ["note_taker.py", "forgemyspec-bundle/note-taker/tests/**"]
  tests: forgemyspec-bundle/note-taker/tests
  pythonpath: ["."]
EOF
H=.forgemyspec/harness
PYTHONPATH=$H python3 -m forgemyspec lint forgemyspec-bundle/note-taker/spec.yaml --formal && PYTHONPATH=$H python3 -m forgemyspec package forgemyspec-bundle/note-taker/spec.yaml; PYTHONPATH=$H python3 -m forgemyspec board start R1; PYTHONPATH=$H python3 -m forgemyspec board
